result.title: T2T Technical Report: Synthesizing GUI Agent Trajectories at Scale from Video Tutorials
result.summary: Training generalist GUI agents requires large volumes of interaction trajectories comprising screenshot sequences paired with grounded UI actions, yet collecting such data through human demonstration is expensive and difficult to scale. Although public software tutorial videos contain rich operational demonstrations, their continuous pixel streams lack discrete action boundaries, semantic intents, and precise spatial coordinates, making them difficult to use directly for model training. To address this, we present T2T (Tutorial-to-Trajectory), a fully automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI agent trajectories at scale. T2T spans desktop, web, and mobile platforms to convert unannotated video tutorials into structured, executable interaction trajectories. To guarantee trajectory quality, T2T combines active segment filtering, keyframe identification via localized UI change, shortcut-free observation frame selection, presence-aware grounding, and two-stage action-space normalization. These refined trajectories are then converted into multi-task training views spanning navigation, planning, forward dynamics, and grounding. We fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B on a subset of the more than one million human-annotation-free training samples generated by this pipeline. Evaluations show that the model achieves consistent gains across multiple benchmarks covering desktop, web, and mobile environments, including OSWorld-G, ScreenSpot-Pro, AndroidControl, and AgentNetBench, indicating improved core capabilities in grounding, step-level instruction execution, and trajectory-level decision-making. Notably, all gains are achieved without any in-distribution training data from target domains. Learning exclusively from trajectories extracted from public videos via the T2T pipeline, the model exhibits cross-application and cross-task generalization capabilities.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出 T2T 自动化流水线，把无标注的软件教学视频转为带截图、定位动作和分段边界的可执行 GUI 交互轨迹，并生成导航、规划、前向动态、定位等多任务训练视图，用于微调 Qwen3-VL-8B。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「无标注视频→分段证据筛选→定位与动作归一化→多任务视图」的流程可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、前向动态式状态监督与轨迹训练提供数据构造参考，但本身不研究 latent 推理状态，联系需进一步核查。
